name: HK USP Compact 9mm

firearm.variant: USP Compact 9 mm x 19, V1 DA/SA

ammunition.load: Federal American Eagle AE9AP 9mm Luger 124 gr FMJ

sources.hk-manual: Heckler & Koch, USP Compact operator's manual DE-EN 987794 (technical data: 9 mm x 19, 13 cartridges, barrel 91 mm, 730 g with empty magazine, magazine 85 g, trigger pull SA approx. 20 N / DA approx. 50 N): https://www.heckler-koch.com/Downloads/Bedienungsanleitungen%20Jagd%20und%20Sport/Pistolen/DE/USP%20Compact%20%20OM%20(DE-EN)%20987794%20002.0320.pdf
sources.hk-usa-manual: HK USA, USP Series operator's manual (slide release automatically holds the slide open when the last shot is fired; magazine drops free regardless of cartridges inside; fires with the magazine removed): https://hk-usa.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/USP-Operators-Manual-8.25.2026-FINAL.pdf
sources.hk-usa-product: HK USA, USP Compact product page (USP9 Compact (V1) DA/SA, 13 rd magazines, 3.58 in barrel, 1.60 lb with empty magazine): https://hk-usa.com/product/usp-compact/
sources.model: Model provenance: assets/library/weapons/hk-compact/README.md (user photographs; Umarex USP Compact leaflet for identification)
sources.federal: Federal Premium, American Eagle AE9AP: 124 gr FMJ, 1150 fps from a 4 in test barrel, velocities at 25/50/75/100 yd 1095/1049/1010/977 fps: https://www.federalpremium.com/handgun/american-eagle/american-eagle-handgun/11-AE9AP.html
sources.federal-le: Federal LE data AE9AP: bullet 8.04 g, BC 0.15, trajectory for a 25 yd zero with 0.9 in sight height (-0.9 / -3.8 / -8.8 in at 50 / 75 / 100 yd): http://le.vistaoutdoor.com/ammunition/federal/handgun/details.aspx?id=93
sources.cip: 9x19 case length 19.15 mm, rim diameter 9.96 mm (CIP TDCC 9 mm Luger, as tabulated in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/9%C3%9719mm_Parabellum)
sources.effective-range: Effective range 50 m: secondary source only (https://www.weaponspecs.com/systems/heckler-koch/heckler-koch-usp/), not published by HK
